{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "max_tokens": 8000, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Annual household listed share and investment fund ownership rates across UK regions by income quintile, 2016–2023

The Office for National Statistics (ONS), in collaboration with financial regulatory authorities, published recurring estimates from the Wealth and Assets Survey between 2016 and 2023. The dataset tracks retail participation rates in listed equities and pooled investment funds, alongside per capita holding amounts across territorial regions and household income quintiles, to evaluate regional wealth inequality and capital market participation trends.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `holding_type` | category | Direct Listed Shares, Pooled Investment Funds; group portfolio |
| `income_quintile` | category | Quintile 1 (Lowest), Quintile 2, Quintile 3, Quintile 4, Quintile 5 (Highest); ordered=ordinal; group socioeconomic |
| `ownership_rate` | measure | unit % of households; non-additive |
| `per_capita_holdings` | measure | unit GBP; additive |
| `region` | category | London, South East, North West, West Midlands, Scotland, Wales and South West; group geography |
| `survey_period` | time | 2016-01-01 to 2023-12-31, monthly; group calendar |

## Figures

- `f01`
    p0: bar, grouped by region, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p0 reads region off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: How listed share ownership rates vary across UK regions and income quintiles
- `f02`
    p0: line, grouped by survey_period, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p0 reads survey_period off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Trend in household equity and investment fund participation rates from 2016 through 2023
- `f03`
    p0: scatter, grouped by nothing, NONE(ownership_rate, per_capita_holdings), unit % of households, GBP
    drawn to answer: Relationship between household ownership rate and per capita holdings value
- `f04`
    p0-p3 each: bar, grouped by region, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p0-p3 each reads region off the axis tick
    p0 is titled 'Quintile 1 (Lowest)'
    p1 is titled 'Quintile 2'
    p2 is titled 'Quintile 3'
    p3 is titled 'Quintile 4'
    the panels are related by: small_multiples
- `f05`
    p0: bar, grouped by region, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p0 reads region off the axis tick
    p1: bar, grouped by income_quintile, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p1 reads income_quintile off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: facet
- `f06`
    p0: bar, grouped by region, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p0 reads region off the axis tick
    p1: grouped_bar, grouped by region, holding_type, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p1 reads region off the axis tick, holding_type off the legend
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f07`
    p0: bar, grouped by region, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households, labelled 'AVG(ownership_rate) [% of households]'
    p0 reads region off the axis tick
    p0: category_line, grouped by region, SUM(per_capita_holdings), unit GBP, labelled 'SUM(per_capita_holdings) [GBP]'
    p0 reads region off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_metric
- `f08`
    p0: bar, grouped by region, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households, labelled '2016-01-01 to 2019-12-16'
    p0 reads region off the axis tick
    p0: category_line, grouped by region, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households, labelled '2019-12-17 to 2023-12-01'
    p0 reads region off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_slice
- `f09`
    p0: bar, grouped by region, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households, labelled 'AVG'
    p0 reads region off the axis tick
    p0: error_bar, grouped by region, FIVE_NUM(ownership_rate), unit % of households, labelled 'spread'
    p0 reads region off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_range
- `f10`
    p0: bar, grouped by region, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p0 reads region off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f11`
    p0: grouped_bar, grouped by region, holding_type, AVG(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p0 reads region off the axis tick, holding_type off the legend
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f12`
    p0: pie, grouped by income_quintile, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads income_quintile off the inline label
- `f13`
    p0: table_chart, grouped by holding_type, region, MEDIAN(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p0 reads holding_type off the inline label, region off the inline label
- `f14`
    p0: bar, grouped by income_quintile, MIN(ownership_rate), unit % of households
    p0 reads income_quintile off the axis tick
- `f15`
    p0: windsock, grouped by survey_period, FIVE_NUM(per_capita_holdings), unit GBP
    p0 reads survey_period off the axis tick
- `f16`
    p0: heatmap, grouped by region, holding_type, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads region off the axis tick, holding_type off the axis tick

## What to write

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| `title` | What the figure shows. Name the quantity and how it is broken down |
| `subtitle` | The qualifier: what each mark covers, over what period |
| `unit` | The unit the values are in, as it would be written on an axis |
| `column_names` | One readable name per column below, used on axes and in legends |
